_note: Model IDs and free-tier limits change often. Check each provider's limits page for YOUR account and edit rpm/rpd/tpm before running. Limits here are deliberately conservative.

groq-gpt-oss-120b._note_extra_body: Low reasoning effort: most gpt-oss output tokens are hidden reasoning, and the free tier allows about 200k tokens per day.
groq-gpt-oss-120b._note_max_output: 4096: at 2048 the claim list of a long summary piece was cut off (finish reason: length). Does not shrink the checker's input budget, which the Qwen backup already limits.

groq-gpt-oss-120b-key2._note: Backup checker: the same model on the second Groq key (separate 200k tokens/day), so scores stay comparable. Replaced Qwen, which Groq now limits to 1000 output tokens per minute.

groq-qwen3.8-27b._note_otpm: 2026-11-26: Groq now limits this model to 1000 output tokens per minute, so requests with max_tokens 4096 are refused. Not used as a backup any more.
groq-qwen3.8-27b._note: Backup checker (Qwen family): separate Groq daily limit, used when gpt-oss-120b's limit is reached.
groq-qwen3.8-27b._note_temperature: Fixed temperature: at 0 Qwen falls into repetition loops that break the JSON output.
groq-qwen3.8-27b._note_max_output: 4096: at 2048 some item reviews were cut off (finish reason: length).

openrouter-nemotron-super._note: NVIDIA family (third family next to Gemini and gpt-oss). OpenRouter free models: 50 requests per day without credits.
openrouter-nemotron-super._note_extra_body: Low reasoning: with default reasoning it used up to ~2k hidden tokens and sometimes hit the output limit.
openrouter-nemotron-super._note_max_output: 8192: reasoning tokens count toward the output limit; at 4096 some checks were cut off (finish reason: length).

openrouter-nemotron-super-key2._note: Same model and settings as openrouter-nemotron-super, second OpenRouter key; used only after the first key's daily limit.
